description: Drives a Daikin air conditioner over the local network, using the plain HTTP API of the BRP069 family of Wi-Fi adapters (BRP069A4x, BRP069B4x, BRP072A4x). The newer BRP072C4x and BRP084 adapters speak different protocols and need their own driver.

config.name: Address
config.description: Address of the Wi-Fi adapter on the local network, for example 192.168.1.50, optionally with a port. Check that the adapter speaks this protocol by opening http://<address>/common/basic_info in a browser: it answers with a line starting with ret=OK.

config.name: Refresh interval
config.description: How often the unit status is read, in seconds. Set to 0 to read it only after a command.

state.name: Exchange step
state.description: Which request is currently waiting for an answer, 0 when idle

state.name: Exchange started
state.description: Uptime in milliseconds when the pending request was sent, used to give up on a lost answer

state.name: Command pending
state.description: Set when a command arrived during another exchange and waits to be sent once it is over

state.name: Requested power
state.description: Power state of the pending command

state.name: Requested target temperature
state.description: Target temperature of the pending command

state.name: Requested fan speed
state.description: Fan speed of the pending command

state.name: Requested vertical airflow
state.description: Vertical vane setting of the pending command

state.name: Requested horizontal airflow
state.description: Horizontal vane setting of the pending command

state.name: Powerful requested
state.description: Whether the commanded fan speed asked for the powerful mode

state.name: Streamer requested
state.description: Whether air cleaning was commanded on

state.name: Powerful on the unit
state.description: Last reported state of the powerful mode: -1 unknown, 0 off, 1 on

state.name: Streamer on the unit
state.description: Last reported state of the streamer: -1 unknown, 0 off, 1 on

state.name: Last refresh timestamp
state.description: Last scheduled refresh in seconds from epoch

state.name: Next refresh timestamp
state.description: Next scheduled refresh in seconds from epoch
